select l.*, r.rule_code, r.rule_name, f.folder_name from base_rule_run l left join base_rule r on l.rule_id = r.id left join base_rule_folder f on r.folder_id = f.id where 1=1
and r.rule_code like concat('%', #{ruleCode}, '%')
and r.rule_name like concat('%', #{ruleName}, '%')
order by l.start_date desc
